card.text: Patchwork moon of Uranus with canyons far deeper than the Grand Canyon.

introduction.text: Miranda's three large coronae are ridged, lightly cratered patches set against older, cratered ground. A rock dropped from its tallest cliff would fall for 10 minutes.

normal.title: Monochrome mosaic
normal.summary: Lighting is corrected, but shadows and seams from the photographs remain; detail varies.

elevation.title: Stereo and shading terrain model
elevation.summary: Heights from stereo images and shading, relative to the source ellipsoid.

geology.title: Geologic map
geology.summary: A historical map of interpreted units; its placement is accurate only to about a degree.

voyager-color.title: Voyager color map
voyager-color.summary: Voyager's own color frames, 1 km per pixel, placed by the moon's limb; the unlit north stays unavailable.
